deviations.official_yaml: attention type flash_attention; mlenv.yml installs flash-attn
deviations.effective: flash-attn 2.8.3.post2 (+cu12, torch 2.7, cp312) installed into the read-only overlay. With it importable the upstream factory selects the FlashAttention class; its own kernels reject the dtypes used here and fall back at run time (24 fallback warnings in the 2-epoch probe) to a manual masked attention that stays finite. Without it the factory builds StandardAttention, whose nn.MultiheadAttention returns NaN for the fully masked remainder chunk because 1279 = 19*64 + 63. NaN is precision- and device-independent (bf16-mixed and 32-true, CPU and CUDA), and 1216/1280/1344 markers are finite, so the published marker count is unusable on the no-flash_attn branch but the attention mathematics is standard in both cases
deviations.decision: keep the upstream attention configuration and supply the package it assumes; NaN is precision- and device-independent, so it is not a bf16 or GPU defect
